about.title: We help businesses reach the right markets and partners.
about.lead: Based in Jeddah, we help companies and projects understand their markets, reach customers and partners, and develop growth opportunities through marketing, research, and business development.
about.body: We start by understanding a project and its market, then identify relevant parties and help shape collaboration around its goals.

about.mission: We provide marketing, market research, and business development to help companies and projects reach suitable customers, partners, and markets.
about.prioritiesHeadline: Practical services for your next business decision
about.tagline: Transforming relationships into opportunities, opportunities into partnerships, and partnerships into growth.
about.bio: A Saudi entrepreneur specializing in business development, attracting companies, and transforming opportunities into thriving partnerships and commercial ventures, alongside forging strategic alliances between business entities. His expertise spans marketing, information and communications technology, economic platforms, hospitality, and smart digital solutions.
about.bioPhilosophy: His work is anchored in a clear, pragmatic philosophy: identifying the right partner, negotiating high-potential opportunities, and structuring collaborative frameworks that generate sustained mutual value for all stakeholders.

privacy.title: Privacy Policy — Working Draft for Review
privacy.lead: This page represents a procedural working draft under legal review by Creative Orbit Marketing Co. management prior to formal public launch.
privacy.note: Company Review Required Prior to Launch
privacy.body: Creative Orbit Marketing Co. is committed to protecting the privacy of visitors, partners, and clients. This draft outlines our guiding principles regarding data handling, communications, and confidentiality under the applicable regulations of the Kingdom of Saudi Arabia.
privacy.pending: The finalized and certified privacy policy, including dedicated Data Protection Officer contact details, will be published upon launch sign-off.

sections.title: 1. Data We Collect
sections.text: Information collected is strictly limited to data voluntarily submitted through our inquiry forms (such as name, company name, phone number, and email address).

sections.title: 2. Purpose of Processing
sections.text: Data submitted is used solely to respond to inquiries, discuss partnership opportunities, and schedule introductory business meetings.

sections.title: 3. WhatsApp & Messaging Channels
sections.text: When continuing via WhatsApp, users are directed through a secure web link prepopulated with their draft text. No automated messages are dispatched without direct user consent and action.

sections.title: 4. Security & Confidentiality
sections.text: We enforce appropriate administrative and technical safeguards to protect business inquiries and prevent unauthorized disclosure.

items.name: Advertising & Marketing
items.description: We plan marketing and advertising activity to help clarify your message and reach your target audience.
items.objectives: Clarify your marketing offer and support communication with your target audience.
items.scope: Depending on the project, scope may include audience and message definition, campaign planning, and content development.
items.fit: You are preparing to launch a product, refresh your brand presence, or improve audience communication.

items.name: Event Management
items.tagline: Events that bring clients and partners together
items.description: We plan and organize events, conferences, and business forums around your goals and intended audience.
items.objectives: Deliver a well-organized event that creates opportunities to connect with relevant audiences and partners.
items.scope: Depending on the agreement, scope may include pre-event coordination, logistics planning, and participant communication.
items.fit: You need to organize an event or conference and coordinate its requirements.

items.name: Market Research & Opinion Polls
items.tagline: A clearer view of your market and customers
items.description: We gather and analyze market and customer information to support business decisions.
items.objectives: Identify findings and questions that help you assess your next options.
items.scope: A study may include market and competitor review, opinion research, and a findings report within the agreed method and scope.
items.fit: You are considering a product launch or market entry, or need to understand customer preferences.

items.name: Business Development & Opportunity Creation
items.tagline: Turn an opportunity into assessable next steps
items.description: We assess commercial opportunities and help identify partners and routes to market.
items.objectives: Shape practical steps to assess and pursue the opportunity.
items.scope: Work may include defining the opportunity, an initial commercial assessment, and suggested steps or potential partners.
items.fit: You have a business idea or project and are exploring a commercial opportunity or expansion path.

items.name: Strategic Partnerships & Alliances
items.description: We help identify potential counterparties, align interests, and coordinate collaboration discussions.
items.objectives: Clarify areas of alignment and possible next steps for collaboration.
items.scope: Work may include identifying potential organizations, arranging introductions and meetings, and supporting discussions. Legal agreements should be reviewed by qualified counsel.
items.fit: You are looking for a partner or need to coordinate collaboration among several parties.

items.name: Investment Attraction & Investor Relations
items.description: We help present business opportunities and coordinate conversations with suitable investors or financing entities.
items.objectives: Present the opportunity clearly and facilitate an initial discussion between parties.
items.scope: Work may include organizing opportunity information, identifying relevant parties, and coordinating introductions or meetings. Funding is not guaranteed.
items.fit: You are exploring potential investors or financing entities for a project.

items.name: Local & International Business Expansion
items.tagline: Plan the next market entry steps
items.description: We help assess target markets and explore local partners to support expansion plans.
items.objectives: Assess options and prepare an expansion plan suited to your needs.
items.scope: Work may include an initial market review, potential partner identification, and entry steps tailored to the country and sector.
items.fit: You are planning to expand within Saudi Arabia or into a regional market.

items.name: Real Estate Activities & Services
items.tagline: Market and coordinate commercial property opportunities
items.description: We provide marketing and connection services for commercial real estate opportunities within the company’s registered activities and under an agreed contract.
items.objectives: Support clear presentation of opportunities and communication between relevant parties.
items.scope: The specific service scope is set by direct agreement and limited to the company’s registered real estate activities.
items.fit: You represent a commercial real estate opportunity and are exploring marketing or relevant connections.
